name: insight-engine
description: YouTube 영상으로 AI 블로그 포스트 자동 생성

scripts.verify:backend: sh -c 'PY=${PYTHON:-python3}; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; fi; "$PY" -m pytest tests --ignore=tests/e2e --ignore=tests/web_feature_test.py --tb=short --timeout=60 -p no:warnings -q && "$PY" -m flake8 . --select=E9,F63,F7,F82 --exclude=__pycache__,migrations,node_modules,.venv,.next --count --show-source --statistics'
scripts.verify:frontend: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run build
scripts.verify:e2e: cd tests/e2e && npx playwright test main-page/ci-smoke.spec.ts --project=no-auth-chromium
scripts.verify:all: npm run verify:backend && npm run verify:frontend && npm run verify:e2e
scripts.verify:audit: npm audit && cd frontend && npm audit && cd ../tests/e2e && npm audit && cd ../.. && npm run verify:python-audit
scripts.verify:python-audit: sh -c 'PY=${PYTHON:-python3}; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; fi; "$PY" scripts/audit_python_dependencies.py'
scripts.verify:production: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; python3 scripts/check_production_readiness.py'
scripts.verify:app-data-backup: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; python3 scripts/backup_app_data.py rehearse --summary'
scripts.ops:monitor: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; PY=${PYTHON:-python3}; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; fi; "$PY" scripts/monitor_readiness.py'
scripts.ops:restore-drill: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; python3 scripts/backup_app_data.py drill-latest --summary'
scripts.ops:host-check: sh -c 'if [ -f .env ]; then set -a; . ./.env; set +a; fi; PY=${PYTHON:-python3}; if [ -x .venv/bin/python ]; then PY=.venv/bin/python; fi; "$PY" scripts/check_host_prereqs.py'
